title: Index Opening Context
objective: Build and test a conditional index opening context playbook.
why: Specialist practice requires explicit evidence, invalidation, risk and stand-aside rules.
core: Separate the overnight auction, cash open, and prior-session references. An opening location is context, not a direction forecast.
Every example is original and synthetic. No pattern is presented as a signal or proven edge.
Verify live specifications, schedules, data entitlements and broker rules before any real decision.
scenario: ES opens above the prior synthetic value area after an overnight rise.
exercise: Write bullish, bearish, and no-trade hypotheses with observable invalidation.
quiz: What makes the playbook falsifiable?
A valid plan states what would disconfirm each path and avoids treating the opening location as a signal.
What remains uncertain?
Outcome, liquidity, slippage, correlations, event response and whether the observed regime persists.
mistake: Treating contextual agreement as proof of direction or edge.
evidence: Official exchange, regulator and economic-calendar sources checked 2026-10-30; original synthetic cases.
